strategy_definitions.honest_go: stated 'going' and ended the epoch inside the bar
strategy_definitions.honest_stay: stated 'staying' and ended the epoch outside the bar
strategy_definitions.false_go: stated 'going' but ended the epoch outside the bar
strategy_definitions.false_stay: stated 'staying' but ended the epoch inside the bar

definitions.gini.final: Max-normalised Gini of final cumulative utility: sum_ij |x_i - x_j| / (2 (n - 1) sum_i |x_i|). Bounded in [0, 1] for signed payoffs; equals n/(n-1) times the classic Gini when all payoffs are non-negative.
definitions.gini.classic: Classic Gini sum_ij |x_i - x_j| / (2 n^2 mean(x)); null when any payoff is negative or the mean is non-positive.
definitions.gini.bar_success: Max-normalised Gini of per-agent counts of comfortable-bar epochs (the only outcome paying the top payoff).
definitions.gini.trajectory: Max-normalised Gini of cumulative utility evaluated after every epoch.
definitions.drift.strategy_space: Behavioural strategy = (stated_intention, realised location) in {honest_go, honest_stay, false_go, false_stay}.
definitions.drift.smoothing: Population shares use additive Jeffreys smoothing (alpha = 0.5) so every divergence is finite.
definitions.drift.kl_step: D_KL(p_t || p_{t-1}) in nats between consecutive population strategy distributions.
definitions.drift.kl_anchor: D_KL(p_t || p_0) in nats: cumulative departure from the opening distribution.
definitions.drift.kl_stationary: D_KL(p_t || p_bar) in nats against the time-pooled distribution of the run.
definitions.drift.js_step: Jensen-Shannon divergence between consecutive distributions in bits, bounded in [0, 1].
definitions.drift.agent_drift: Per-agent D_KL(late || early) in nats between that agent's strategy mix in the final and opening windows.
definitions.drift.entropy: Shannon entropy of the smoothed population strategy distribution in bits (max 2).
definitions.nash.pure_attendance: Attendance levels A at which no goer gains by staying home and no stayer gains by going, given the exact payoff rule.
definitions.nash.mixed_go_probability: Symmetric mixed equilibrium p* solving u_c F(T-1; N-1, p) + u_x (1 - F) = u_h with the exact binomial CDF F; p* = 1 when going is dominant.
definitions.nash.gap: Realised attendance minus the nearest pure-equilibrium attendance, per epoch.
definitions.nash.regret: Exact ex-post unilateral deviation gain per agent-epoch; epsilon is the per-epoch maximum, so the profile is an epsilon-Nash equilibrium.
definitions.nash.efficiency: Realised total utility divided by the welfare-maximising total utility.
definitions.nash.welfare_gap: Realised mean utility minus the mean payoff at the pure Nash equilibrium.
definitions.nash.late_window: Late metrics use the final window_fraction of epochs to isolate converged behaviour.
definitions.contrast.design: delta2 minus control. Paired by seed when seeds overlap (common initial positions); unpaired otherwise.
definitions.contrast.ci95: Hierarchical percentile bootstrap: seeds resampled with replacement, then agents (agent-level metrics) or circular blocks of epochs (time-series metrics) within each seed.
definitions.contrast.p_value: Exact two-sided sign-flip test over seed-level paired differences, or exact two-sided permutation test over seed-level values when unpaired.
definitions.phase.changepoint: Single change point minimising the two-segment within-segment sum of squares; r2 is the variance explained by the split.
definitions.phase.coupled_transition: Legacy coupled detector from analyze_results.detect_phase_transition (rolling deception spike against utility crash).
definitions.minds.instinct_agreement: Share of agent-epochs where the LLM's realised strategy matched the argmax of the agent's own bounded-rational softmax instinct.
definitions.minds.honesty_lie_spearman: Spearman rank correlation between each agent's honesty trait and its lie rate; negative means personality drives deception.
definitions.minds.reputation_gap_honest_minus_liars: Final public reputation of agents whose broadcasts were mostly true minus that of agents whose broadcasts were mostly false.
